summary: The complete g509 regression batch compiled all six targets, including the corrected native-to-WebRTC fixture and unchanged default server check. All selected runtime tests ran: 2,176 of 2,200 passed, 24 failed, none skipped. The pooled-session cleanup correction also passed this complete batch. Failures comprise three Core fixture ordering errors, five Native replacement/overlap/contention fixture gaps, four WebRTC fixtures missing physical observer ownership, nine SIP storage failures, two Vapi persistence failures, and one intermittent scene-expiry failure. Reviewed source corrections are staged for Core, Native, WebRTC and Vapi; SIP exact-parent insertion is under independent review. These corrections remain unverified at runtime. Expiry diagnostics show monotonic/wall-clock disagreement near the deadline, but do not yet establish the first revocation cause. All original processes closed naturally and source/artifacts were independently audited. Three decoded-media representatives, strict Firefox three-cycle validation, final qualification, ARM11, normal release builds and preflight remain after the corrected regressions pass. Latest full matrix remains v218: 1/32 cells, 399/432 checks passed; G6-054 stays parked. Local Mac/native ARM only; criteria unchanged.
